training_snr_distribution: continuous Uniform[-4,4] dB independently for each corrupted occurrence
snr_definition: centered clean signal power / expected Gaussian noise power; report realized SNR separately
normalization: inject before per-window mean/std; same observation for both branches
scaler: fit clean selected training subset only, median/IQR floor0.05 clip8
sampling: same class-record-window sampling with replacement as clean protocol
loss: one mean CE on mixed batch, label smoothing0.05; no separately weighted losses
variants: fusion all four budgets; whole physics fusion module removed only at full budget
freeze: all33 models frozen before test prediction
